approvalPacketStatement: All required chain images (1-cli-worker, 2-serverless-handler, 3-volume-mapped-handler) must be published consistently, each pinned by full source SHA with no floating tag. Publishing only the CLI image is insufficient and would not fix the canary, because the currently published Serverless and volume-mapped images derive from the old buggy CLI digest and would remain broken. Any source, base-digest, or dependency change to ANY of the three candidates invalidates this entire readiness record for the whole chain, not just the changed image. Publication of any or all three images requires a separate, explicit Gate 2 approval per image (or a single approval explicitly covering all three, at the approver's discretion) -- it is not implied by this build-only readiness review. Publication of the chain does NOT itself authorize Gate 3; a further separate, explicit Gate 3 approval is required afterward, and must reference the new final volume-mapped handler digest (role 3) specifically, not the digest used in the two prior failed canaries.
